name: ColliderKind
declaration: public enum ColliderKind : uint
summary: Primitive or cooked geometry selection. Cooked geometry is resolved by the asset worker.

values.name: Capsule
values.summary: Y-axis capsule using cylinder half height and radius.

values.name: Cylinder
values.summary: Y-axis cylinder using half height and radius.

values.name: Cooked
values.summary: Immutable cooked hull, mesh, terrain or compound, attached as CookedCollider.

values.name: ModelConvex
values.summary: Convex hull from the selected cooked model geometry; supports moving bodies.

values.name: ModelMesh
values.summary: Triangle surface from the selected cooked model geometry; static bodies only.
